openQuestions.question: Heading not changed. The baseline heading is "§7 — Let the architects speak" and the current heading is "Let the Architects Speak". Only the section number differs. The volume card lists sections 1 through 16 as a protected structural device, and the numbering is absent from the current headings. Renaming a heading mints and retires a public route, so the difference is recorded here rather than acted on.
